note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962 UBS wording; the English Rooted keeps the BSB, but its Amharic edition quotes the Amharic Bible, now OWB (as Rooted book 3 did, #8384). Each day's epigraph quotes its cited range whole, and the day's teaching quotes the same OWB words wherever it echoes the epigraph; Gospel dialogue the teaching retells inside quote marks (Mark 4:35, John 2:7-8, John 4:9, Matthew 14:27, Luke 19:7 and others) is OWB too.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'; verbatim recitations without quote marks count. `self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions, the author's retellings and bare citations. Where the teaching argues from a word OWB words differently, the prose follows OWB: John 3:3 'born again' is OWB «ከላይ ካልተወለደ» ('born from above'), glossed once in the teaching; the Beatitudes' «ብፁዓን» is OWB «የተባረኩ» (and 'meek' is ገሮች); 'Follow Me' is «ኑ፣ ተከተሉኝ» (still two words, and the day-9 title follows it); 'Savior' is አዳኝ; Lazarus's call is «አልዓዛር፣ ውጣ!» (the day-18 title follows it); the prodigal's 'hired servant' is ተቀጣሪ ሠራተኛ; the steward of the feast is የድግሱ ኃላፊ.
